entries.subject: DAMIT 10836: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-10836.txt. Model 10836, version 2022-11-29, pole (109°, 30°), period 6.37023 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 26.538 ±0.262 km. The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.,Quoted ±0.262 km is the catalog fit error; approximately 10% additional systematic diameter uncertainty applies.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT matches
entries.finding: The current DAMIT metadata export lists only selected model 10836 for this target; no other DAMIT shape is available in this listing to adopt. The imported 'included' status did not mean a second model was rendered. This check says nothing about unexamined archives.
entries.revisitWhen: The target obtains another DAMIT release or a concrete model is identified in a different archive.
